DODGE_AND_SURVIVE.procedure: Monitor threats → decide evasive action → execute avoidance

INFER_AND_DECIDE.procedure: Perceive evidence → reason about causes → select explanation/action

ENGAGE_AND_DEFEAT.procedure: Identify target → approach → attack/interact → verify elimination

NAVIGATE_AND_REACH.procedure: Plan path to target position → move there → confirm arrival and stability

EXPLORE_AND_DISCOVER.procedure: Probe unknown space → observe result → update knowledge

COMPARE_AND_RANK.procedure: Perceive multiple options, compare by position, select and label extremes

SEQUENCE_AND_COMPLETE.procedure: Break goal into ordered sub-steps → execute each in order → verify

TIME_AND_REACT.procedure: Wait for trigger → execute precisely timed actions → respond to environment

EVALUATE_AND_OPTIMIZE.procedure: Assess state quality → try improvements → compare and select best action sequence

RECALL_MATCH_AND_SELECT.procedure: Retrieve criteria → perceive options → match references → select and confirm

POSITION_AND_PLACE.procedure: Perceive target location → move/arrange item → verify placement

TRANSFORM_AND_VERIFY.procedure: Apply transformation to state → verify new state matches goal

MONITOR_AND_SUSTAIN.procedure: Track transition condition → maintain action → ensure completion and presence

INPUT_AND_SUBMIT.procedure: Perceive form/field → enter value → submit → verify acceptance

FILTER_AND_NARROW.procedure: Apply criteria to items → eliminate non-matching → act on matched item

COLLECT_AND_ACCUMULATE.procedure: Identify collectible → move to it → acquire → track count

COUNT_AND_REPORT.procedure: Identify attribute → count matching items → output total count

RETRIEVE_AND_EXECUTE.procedure: Recall known procedure → execute it → confirm outcome
